interpolation.description: For each trajectory, randomly mask this fraction of its INTERNAL tokens (the same positions kappa is defined on: excluding the two endpoints t=1, t=T). Mask count = floor(level * (T - 2)). All six methods (M0-M5, plan §7.2) are evaluated against the SAME mask pattern for a given (prompt_id, sample_index, level) -- masks are derived deterministically from mask_seed plus that sample's own identity, never redrawn per method.

extrapolation.description: Remove the trailing 20% of each trajectory; predict those positions from the leading 80%.
